goal: Reject oversized outbound P2P messages and types before queuing them for transport
Prevents buffer overruns or encoding aborts and avoids unexpected peer disconnects
agreement: Concept approval without stated reasons (ajtowns, naiyoma)
Unaddressed objection: added Assume could trigger in -privatebroadcast on oversized witness (mzumsande)

categories.name: p2p
why: P2 because it prevents transport encoding buffer overruns and aborts from oversized message types
Protects peer communication from silent corruption or crashes during outbound encoding

categories.name: rpc
why: P4 because it improves parameter validation on a testing RPC
Returns an explicit error for payloads over 4 MB instead of disconnecting peers downstream
